newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower in all months on Tuesday after continued selling orders from local investors, and traders said the market is likely to fall further in the near term.
Prices were 0.4 to 1.2 yen per kg lower, and benchmark March 1997 contract was down 0.6 yen at 134.1.
The ample supply of rubber stocks in Japan is still a major bearish factor, and local investors could not find any bullish factors at the moment, the traders said.
The distant month is likely to fall below 130 yen in the near term, the traders said.
